regions.today: Sunny spells and mostly dry weather continuing into this evening with southwesterly breezes.
regions.tonight: Mostly dry at first tonight with clear spells and isolated showers. Cloud will build from the southwest with rain following later in the night. The rain will be heavy or thundery in places with localised flooding possible. Lowest temperatures of 11 to 14 degrees in mostly moderate to fresh southerly winds, strengthening in southern areas towards morning.
regions.tomorrow: A wet start tomorrow with outbreaks of rain, heavy or thundery in places. A clearance to sunny spells and isolated showers will follow from the southwest by the early to mid-afternoon. Moderate to fresh and gusty southerly winds, stronger at times near coasts, will veer westerly as the rain clears, and will ease in the evening. Highest temperatures of 14 to 18 degrees.
regions.solar_uv: Low to moderate on Saturday. Low on Sunday.
